# PDF regression fixtures

`encrypted.pdf` is a synthetic one-page PDF created for this project during the
2026-09-07 review. It contains only the text `3000mm`; test passwords are
`user-test` and `owner-test`. It has no user document content. The test checks
that password-protected input fails with a structured error. Generating a PDF
with a library does not make that library a runtime dependency of the fixture.

Other PDFs are generated by the minimal fixture writer in `test_pdf_tools.py`,
which does not use a PDF parsing library.
